### Findings, each with its disposition

- Dev (H5), confirmed at source: a lookup-typed `groupByField` puts every record under one `[object Object]` lane header (`String(m.group)`). There is no crash, and whether to group by id or by name is a design question ⇒ **recorded**. No card is filed: no in-repo producer authors a lookup `groupByField` on a timeline, so there is no measured reach.
- Dev (H4), confirmed at source: static `schema.items` with an object-valued `title` still throws. It is the author-literal pass-through, with no fetch and no expansion, and no producer ⇒ **recorded**.
- Dev, inference that the reviewer confirmed accurate: `NavigationOverlay` prints `String(value ?? '—')`, and `ObjectGallery`'s card title does `String(item[titleField])`, so an expanded lookup reads `[object Object]` on both ⇒ **recorded**, as the candidate carrier for the next record-display sweep.
- Reviewer nit: the changeset's "pins each case above" overstates per-slot coverage. The title slot pins the lookup / string / number / bare-id cases; the boolean / zero / blank cases are pinned on the description slot. One function serves both ⇒ **Acceptance notes**.

- **PR assignee not set.** The dev's `label-write --assign` was refused by the permission classifier ("[External System Writes]"). The seat does not re-issue a refused write. The PR joins the list awaiting the maintainer on seat post objectui#9771.
